column1: # mapping_set_title: VCF Core Vocabulary: external alignments

# mapping_set_description: The single curated record of every alignment vcf-core asserts against an external vocabulary. This file is the source of truth: vcf-core-alignments.ttl is generated from it by scripts/build-mapping-sets.py. Rows commented 'Also asserted inline in the vcf-core ontology modules' are additionally present in ontology/*.ttl and reach anyone loading the bundle; the rest reach only those who load the alignment module.

# comment: vrs: is GA4GH VRS 2.0, the version this vocabulary targets. vrs1: is VRS 1.3 and appears only in the bh25/ sets, whose curators worked against VRS 1.2/1.3; several terms they mapped to (Genotype, Haplotype, SequenceInterval, ChromosomeLocation, Text, Gene, Feature, UtilityVariation) were removed in 2.0.
